@aboutThis.ownerPlace.sandboxHome.description: The Library folder an app's data sits in, shown muted beside it in the "Its data in your Library" list of the "Tell me about this" card. A sandboxed Linux app's own home folder (~/.var/app or ~/snap).

aboutThis.removal.uncommittedWork: It has changes no commit holds, so git can’t bring those back.

@aboutThis.removal.uncommittedWork.description: One line under "What removing it means" on the "Tell me about this" card: the item has uncommitted changes in git. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.untrackedNotInGit: Git doesn’t track it, so git can’t bring it back.

@aboutThis.removal.untrackedNotInGit.description: One line under "What removing it means": the item is in a git repository but git keeps no copy of it. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.ignoredByGit: Git ignores it, so git can’t bring it back.

@aboutThis.removal.ignoredByGit.description: One line under "What removing it means": an ignore rule covers the item, so git keeps no copy. It doesn't claim any tool can recreate it. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.userDocument: Nothing Cmdr knows of made this or could make it again.

@aboutThis.removal.userDocument.description: One line under "What removing it means": no app, installer, or tool Cmdr knows of created the item or could recreate it, so it's likely the person's own. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.removesApp: This removes the app. Cmdr can’t tell yet how much of its data stays in your Library.

@aboutThis.removal.removesApp.description: One line under "What removing it means" for an app, when Cmdr doesn't know (yet) which of its folders in the user's Library would stay behind. "Library" is the macOS folder of that name.

aboutThis.removal.removesAppDataLeft: {count, plural, =0 {This removes the app. Cmdr’s index knows of none of its data in your Library.} one {{atLeast, select, yes {This removes the app. Its data in your Library stays: at least <size></size> in one folder.} other {This removes the app. Its data in your Library stays: <size></size> in one folder.}}} other {{atLeast, select, yes {This removes the app. Its data in your Library stays: at least <size></size> in {countText} folders.} other {This removes the app. Its data in your Library stays: <size></size> in {countText} folders.}}}}

@aboutThis.removal.removesAppDataLeft.description: One line under "What removing it means" for an app: how much of the app's data in the user's Library would stay behind. <size></size> becomes the total size. "At least" when Cmdr's index hasn't listed some of it.

atLeast.description: "yes" when the total may be larger.

aboutThis.removal.appData: {certainty, select, probable {It’s probably {app}’s data, and {app} may lose what it keeps here.} other {It’s {app}’s data, and {app} may lose what it keeps here.}}

@aboutThis.removal.appData.description: One line under "What removing it means": the item holds an installed app's data, and that app may lose settings or content. "probably" when Cmdr matched it by name only. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.installedByReceipt: {partOfOs, select, yes {macOS installed it, and parts of macOS may need it.} other {The package {pkgId} installed it, and what it installed may need it.}}

@aboutThis.removal.installedByReceipt.description: One line under "What removing it means": an installer put the item here, and the software it installed may need it. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.installedByHomebrew: Homebrew installed it as part of {name}, which may stop working.

@aboutThis.removal.installedByHomebrew.description: One line under "What removing it means": Homebrew (a package manager; keep the name) installed the item, and that software may stop working. A consequence, never advice.

name.description: The formula's or cask's name, for example "ffmpeg".

aboutThis.removal.leftoverOfUninstalledA: It’s named after {bundleId}, an app that isn’t installed. Cmdr can’t tell whether anything else uses it.

@aboutThis.removal.leftoverOfUninstalled.description: One line under "What removing it means": the folder is named after an app that isn't installed. The second sentence keeps it honest: Cmdr doesn't know whether something else still uses it. Never say it's safe to delete.

aboutThis.removal.recordedDownload: {platform, select, macos {macOS recorded this as downloaded from {host}. Cmdr can’t tell whether the site still has it.} other {Your browser recorded this as downloaded from {host}. Cmdr can’t tell whether the site still has it.}}

@aboutThis.removal.recordedDownload.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a downloaded file. It says only what was recorded; it never promises the file can be downloaded again.

aboutThis.removal.gitCanRestore: Git can restore it from the last commit.

@aboutThis.removal.gitCanRestore.description: One line under "What removing it means": git tracks the item with no changes, so git can bring it back. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.rebuildablePackageMana: A package manager can fetch this again, which takes time and a network.

@aboutThis.removal.rebuildablePackageMan.description: One line under "What removing it means" for installed dependencies (like node_modules): a package manager can download them again. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.rebuildableBuildTool: A build tool can make this again, which takes time.

@aboutThis.removal.rebuildableBuildTool.description: One line under "What removing it means" for build output: the build tool that made it can make it again. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.regeneratedCache: {hasApp, select, yes {It’s {app}’s cache: {app} writes it again, and is slower until it has.} other {It’s a cache: whatever wrote it writes it again, and is slower until it has.}}

@aboutThis.removal.regeneratedCache.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a cache folder. A consequence, never advice.

app.description: The app whose cache it is, for example "Slack".

hasApp.description: "yes" when Cmdr knows whose cache it is.

aboutThis.removal.otherNamesRemain: {count, plural, one {One other name points to the same contents, which stays.} other {{countText} other names point to the same contents, which stays.}}

@aboutThis.removal.otherNamesRemain.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a file with hard links: removing this name leaves the contents reachable through the others. A consequence, never advice.

count.description: How many other names, as a number.

aboutThis.removal.linkOnly: It’s a link: removing it leaves what it points to.

@aboutThis.removal.linkOnly.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a symbolic link. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.cantTell: Cmdr can’t tell what depends on this.

@aboutThis.removal.cantTell.description: One line under "What removing it means" when Cmdr doesn't know enough to say. An honest answer, never a warning or advice.

@aboutThis.removal.more.description: Button under "What removing it means" that shows the rest of the consequences beyond the first two. No closing period.

count.description: How many more, as a number.

@aboutThis.removal.less.description: Button under "What removing it means" that hides the extra consequences again. No closing period.

@aboutThis.label.gitSnapshot.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card for an item inside git's history view (a file as it was in a branch, tag, commit, or stash entry), not a file on the disk. Short, sentence case.

@aboutThis.unknown.volumeStoppedAnswerin.description: Muted one-line answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the item's drive or server stopped answering while the card was gathering. A note at the top of the card already says so in a full sentence, so this stays short. No closing period.

@aboutThis.unknown.notFound.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the item moved or was removed after the file list showed it.

@aboutThis.download.insideArchive.description: First line of the "Where it came from" row on the "Tell me about this" card for a file inside a zip or other archive: the file has no download record of its own, so the row names the archive it sits in.

archive.description: The archive's file name, exactly as it appears in the file list ("Photos.zip").

aboutThis.download.archiveRecord: {platform, select, macos {What macOS recorded about the archive:} other {What your browser recorded about the archive:}}

@aboutThis.download.archiveRecord.description: Quiet line on the "Tell me about this" card for a file inside an archive, right above the archive's own download record (where the archive was downloaded from). Makes clear the lines that follow are about the archive, not the file inside it.

platform.description: The OS Cmdr runs on: macos or other.

aboutThis.gitSnapshot.from: {kind, select, branch {As the branch {name} has it in <repo></repo>} tag {As the tag {name} has it in <repo></repo>} commit {As commit {name} has it in <repo></repo>} other {As stash entry {name} has it in <repo></repo>}}

@aboutThis.gitSnapshot.from.description: The "Git history" row on the "Tell me about this" card, for a file inside git's history view: which branch, tag, commit, or stash entry this version of the file comes from, and which repository. <repo></repo> becomes the repository's folder name.

kind.description: branch, tag, commit, or other (a stash entry).

name.description: The branch or tag name, a commit's short id ("1a2b3c4"), or the stash entry's number.

aboutThis.gitSnapshot.lastChanged: Last changed by a commit on <date></date>

@aboutThis.gitSnapshot.lastChanged.description: Quiet second line of the "Git history" row on the "Tell me about this" card: when a commit last changed this file in that branch or commit. <date></date> becomes a date. No closing period.

@aboutThis.gitSnapshot.copyCommit.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the copy button beside a commit on the "Tell me about this" card. Copies the commit's full id.

aboutThis.headline.insideArchive: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, inside {archive}

@aboutThis.headline.insideArchive.description: One-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a file inside an archive, for example "Image, 2 MB, inside Photos.zip". <size></size> becomes a size.

what.description: What the item is, already worded ("Image", "Folder", "Item in an archive").

sizeShown.description: Whether a size follows: exact, atLeast, or other (no size).

archive.description: The archive's file name, exactly as it appears in the file list.

aboutThis.headline.fromGitHistory: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, {kind, select, branch {as the branch {name} has it} tag {as the tag {name} has it} commit {as commit {name} has it} other {as stash entry {name} has it}}

@aboutThis.headline.fromGitHistory.description: One-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a file inside git's history view, for example "Swift file, 4 KB, as commit 1a2b3c4 has it". <size></size> becomes a size.

what.description: What the item is, already worded ("Image", "Folder", "Item in an archive").

sizeShown.description: Whether a size follows: exact, atLeast, or other (no size).

kind.description: branch, tag, commit, or other (a stash entry).

name.description: The branch or tag name, a commit's short id, or the stash entry's number.

aboutThis.removal.holdsRepoHistory: It holds the repository’s whole history. Removing it leaves the files but drops every commit that isn’t pushed somewhere else, and Cmdr can’t tell what’s pushed.

@aboutThis.removal.holdsRepoHistory.description: One line under "What removing it means" on the "Tell me about this" card, for a repository's own data folder (".git"). A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.inGitHistory: This is git’s record of it at that point in history, not a file on the disk, so there’s nothing to remove here.

@aboutThis.removal.inGitHistory.description: The line under "What removing it means" on the "Tell me about this" card for a file inside git's history view (a past version kept by git). A fact, never advice.

aboutThis.verdict.label: AI wrote this

@aboutThis.verdict.label.description: Heading of the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card. The "AI take" is two or three sentences an AI model writes about the item from the facts the card lists, shown in its own block, set apart from the facts, right above "What removing it means". It says plainly that the text below was written by an AI, not by Cmdr, so nobody mistakes it for one of Cmdr's own facts. Short label, sentence case.

@aboutThis.verdict.writing.description: Quiet placeholder in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card while the AI hasn't written anything yet (the facts may still be landing, or the request is on its way). The "AI take" is two or three sentences an AI model writes about the item from the facts the card lists, shown in its own block, set apart from the facts, right above "What removing it means". Ends with an ellipsis.

@aboutThis.verdict.stop.description: Button in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card, shown while the AI is writing. Stops the AI take alone; the card and its facts stay, and the text written so far stays too. Short control label.

aboutThis.verdict.stopTooltip: Stops the AI take. The facts and what it wrote so far stay.

@aboutThis.verdict.stopTooltip.description: Tooltip on the Stop button of the AI take on the "Tell me about this" card.

@aboutThis.verdict.stopped.description: Quiet mark after the text of the AI take on the "Tell me about this" card when the person stopped it (or cloud AI was turned off) before the AI finished. The text so far stays. One word.

@aboutThis.verdict.fromEarlier.description: Quiet tag beside the AI take's heading on the "Tell me about this" card when the take was written earlier in this session for the same, unchanged item, so Cmdr showed it again without asking the AI. Short.

@aboutThis.verdict.announcement.description: Read aloud once by screen readers when the AI take on the "Tell me about this" card is complete. Not shown on screen.

text.description: The AI's two or three sentences, as written.

aboutThis.verdict.given.none: From the facts above. Cmdr didn’t look inside.

@aboutThis.verdict.given.none.description: Line under the AI take's heading on the "Tell me about this" card, shown from the moment the request goes out, saying what the AI was given: only the facts the card lists, nothing from inside the item (a folder, an item on a server, or a file whose contents gave nothing to read).

aboutThis.verdict.given.firstLines: From the facts above and its first lines.

@aboutThis.verdict.given.firstLines.description: Line under the AI take's heading on the "Tell me about this" card, shown from the moment the request goes out, saying what the AI was given: the facts the card lists plus the first few lines of the text file.

aboutThis.verdict.given.firstPage: From the facts above and the first page.

@aboutThis.verdict.given.firstPage.description: Line under the AI take's heading on the "Tell me about this" card, shown from the moment the request goes out, saying what the AI was given: the facts the card lists plus the PDF's title and first page.

aboutThis.verdict.given.entryNames: From the facts above and the names of the first files inside.

@aboutThis.verdict.given.entryNames.description: Line under the AI take's heading on the "Tell me about this" card, shown from the moment the request goes out, saying what the AI was given: the facts the card lists plus the names of the first files inside the archive (a zip, for example). Not their contents.

aboutThis.verdict.given.cameraDetails: From the facts above and the photo’s camera details, without its location.

@aboutThis.verdict.given.cameraDetails.description: Line under the AI take's heading on the "Tell me about this" card, shown from the moment the request goes out, saying what the AI was given: the facts the card lists plus the photo's camera make, model, lens, and date. The photo's location is never sent.

aboutThis.verdict.given.protected: From the facts above. This is somewhere Cmdr keeps contents private, so it didn’t look inside.

@aboutThis.verdict.given.protected.description: Line under the AI take's heading on the "Tell me about this" card, shown from the moment the request goes out, for an item in a place whose contents Cmdr never sends to an AI (passwords and keys, a browser profile, mail): only its name-level facts went.

aboutThis.verdict.problem.authFailed: Your AI provider didn’t accept the key.

@aboutThis.verdict.problem.authFailed.description: Quiet line in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card when the AI provider refused the API key, so there's no take this time. Never uses the words "error" or "failed".

aboutThis.verdict.problem.rateLimited: Your AI provider’s limit is reached for now.

@aboutThis.verdict.problem.rateLimited.description: Quiet line in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card when the AI provider turned the request away for a rate limit or a used-up quota. Never uses the words "error" or "failed".

aboutThis.verdict.problem.unreachable: Cmdr couldn’t reach your AI provider.

@aboutThis.verdict.problem.unreachable.description: Quiet line in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card when the AI provider didn't answer (offline, or it timed out). Never uses the words "error" or "failed".

aboutThis.verdict.problem.overloaded: Your AI provider is busy right now.

@aboutThis.verdict.problem.overloaded.description: Quiet line in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card when the AI provider said it's overloaded. Never uses the words "error" or "failed".

aboutThis.verdict.problem.managed: Your IT team’s policy stopped this on its way out.

@aboutThis.verdict.problem.managed.description: Quiet line in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card when the organization's device policy (set by an IT team) refused the request before it left the Mac. Never uses the words "error" or "failed".

aboutThis.verdict.problem.noAnswer: The AI didn’t write anything this time.

@aboutThis.verdict.problem.noAnswer.description: Quiet line in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card when the AI's answer came back empty. Never uses the words "error" or "failed".

aboutThis.verdict.problem.other: Your AI provider couldn’t answer this time.

@aboutThis.verdict.problem.other.description: Quiet line in the AI take's block on the "Tell me about this" card when the AI provider answered with a problem Cmdr has no specific words for. Never uses the words "error" or "failed".

aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.noCloudCon: Cloud AI needs your OK before Cmdr can write a short AI take here.

@aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.noCloudCo.description: One quiet line on the "Tell me about this" card, in place of the AI take, when cloud AI is picked but not allowed (or was allowed under older wording of what it sends, so it needs allowing again). A link beside it opens Settings at the full list of what cloud AI gets; the card never allows it in one click.

aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.notConfigu: Add your AI provider’s key in Settings for a short AI take here.

@aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.notConfig.description: One quiet line on the "Tell me about this" card, in place of the AI take, when a cloud AI provider is picked but has no key or address set up. A link beside it opens Settings > AI.

aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.modelOff: Cmdr writes AI takes only with models it’s tested for this, and your model isn’t one of them.

@aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.modelOff.description: One quiet line on the "Tell me about this" card, in place of the AI take, when the picked cloud AI model isn't one whose takes Cmdr has tested and found careful enough (it never measured it, or it measured it and the model made claims it shouldn't). The facts above still show in full. No link: there's nothing to fix in Settings unless the person picks a different model.

aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.notReady: The local AI model isn’t running, so there’s no AI take this time.

@aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.notReady.description: One quiet line on the "Tell me about this" card, in place of the AI take, when the on-device AI model's server isn't running. The card never starts it.

aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.tooManyReq: That’s a lot of AI takes in a minute. Try again in a moment.

@aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.tooManyRe.description: One quiet line on the "Tell me about this" card, in place of the AI take, when many cards were opened within a minute and Cmdr held back to keep the cost down.

@aboutThis.verdict.unavailable.openAiSet.description: Link beside a hint about the AI take on the "Tell me about this" card (cloud AI needs allowing, no key set up, or AI is off). Opens Settings > AI. Short link text.

aboutThis.verdict.aiOffHint: AI is off, so there’s no AI take.

@aboutThis.verdict.aiOffHint.description: Quiet hint in the footer of the "Tell me about this" card when AI is turned off in Settings: the card shows only Cmdr's own facts. A link beside it opens Settings > AI. The "AI take" is two or three sentences an AI model writes about the item from the facts the card lists, shown in its own block, set apart from the facts, right above "What removing it means".

@aboutThis.action.continueInAskCmdr.description: Button (or a row behind "More") in the footer of the "Tell me about this" card, shown while Ask Cmdr is on. Closes the card and opens Ask Cmdr, the app's AI chat panel, on a new chat with this item attached and a short question typed in but not sent. "Ask Cmdr" is the feature's name and stays verbatim. Short control label.

aboutThis.action.continueInAskCmdrToolti: Opens a new Ask Cmdr chat about this item. Nothing is sent until you send it.

@aboutThis.action.continueInAskCmdrToolt.description: Tooltip on the "Continue in Ask Cmdr" button of the "Tell me about this" card. "Ask Cmdr" is the feature's name and stays verbatim.

@aboutThis.continueInAskCmdr.draft.description: The question "Continue in Ask Cmdr" on the "Tell me about this" card types into Ask Cmdr's message box, unsent, with the item attached. The person can edit it before sending. Written as the person speaking to the assistant, in their own voice. Always this same sentence: it never quotes anything from the card.

aboutThis.label.name: Name

@aboutThis.label.name.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, in "What it is", shown only when the item's name hides a character that changes the order text shows in. Short label.

aboutThis.identity.nameHidReordering: Its name hides a character that flips the text’s direction, so in other apps it can seem to end differently. Cmdr shows it without that character.

@aboutThis.identity.nameHidReordering.description: The "Name" row on the "Tell me about this" card, shown only when the item's real name holds an invisible character that reverses the order the text shows in (a Unicode direction override), a trick that makes a program look like, say, a PDF in some apps. Cmdr dropped the character everywhere it shows the name, so the title and rows show its real ending. Plain words, no jargon like "Unicode" or "bidi".
